working_contract.working_role: JGA controller and Riseklix processor for participant information processed on JGA’s behalf; each separately responsible for own business-contact/invoicing/legal records.
working_contract.role_change_rule: Document a materially different research role before collection.
working_contract.tools_rule: No sub-processor or external recording/transcription/AI service receives identifiable or confidential research data without JGA prior written authorisation and appropriate contractual safeguards.
working_contract.access_rule: Record approved tools, recipients, hosting and access locations before collection; establish any required international-transfer safeguards and assessment before JGA-controlled personal data is made accessible outside the UK. The agreement is not itself an IDTA.
working_contract.fallback_rule: JGA may retain identifiable contacts/responses and supply genuinely anonymised material while required safeguards are not in place. Do not treat remote access or pseudonymous records as anonymisation.
working_contract.closure_trigger: Completion or termination; at JGA choice, with technically necessary backups and protected legally required-record exceptions as stated in section12.
working_contract.participant_notice_rule: JGA supplies appropriate notices and lawful collection instructions; actual permissions and attribution/quotation/sharing limits recorded.
working_contract.sensitive_data_rule: Do not request employee payroll records, special-category data or unnecessary personal information.

release_decisions.title: Focus, guide and introduction route
release_decisions.needed_before_use: Client confirmation of the proposed population/focus, current core guide and practical introduction route; actual working dates/burden agreed.
release_decisions.basis: DEC-002, DEC-004, DEC-006 and existing WP02 review remain open.

release_decisions.title: Actual data flow and authorised access
release_decisions.needed_before_use: Document the tools/storage, authorised people/recipients, hosting/access locations, security/retention implementation and any required transfer route/assessment.
release_decisions.basis: Contract section12 is the baseline; no account or tool has been approved through this pack.

release_decisions.title: Participant information and collection instructions
release_decisions.needed_before_use: JGA-approved privacy information, lawful collection instructions, actual contact/rights and incident-escalation route, purpose/recipient/retention details and correction/withdrawal handling.
release_decisions.basis: Voluntary research agreement is separate from selecting a data-protection lawful basis; no basis automatically chosen.

release_decisions.title: Publication and optional uses
release_decisions.needed_before_use: Define this edition/report/licensing scope, de-identification checks, quote/name/employer clearance and any future-use/recontact/Table choices separately.
release_decisions.responsible_party: JGA and participant through approved route
release_decisions.basis: No assumed future-edition reuse, personal-data sale or sponsor access; contract rights remain subject to participant restrictions.

release_decisions.title: Release and first collection
release_decisions.needed_before_use: User permission for the exact external message/route, client/data arrangements confirmed, actual participant information/choices provided and recorded before collecting substantive input.
release_decisions.basis: No sending or collection is authorised by an empty template or a synthetic check.
